lesson.menu_title: Executive Communication -- Reporting Back: What They Said at the Kickoff
lesson.menu_desc: The deal is signed and the integration starts. Report back to the board after the kickoff with reported speech -- "Mark said that the brand would stay", "Priya asked me to send the org chart" -- and flag the first risk to the steering committee
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 21 -- Executive Communication -- Reporting Back: What They Said at the Kickoff
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Carlos Vinicius Vale Bassan | Lesson 21 -- Reporting Back
lesson.grammar_point: reported speech (said that, told + person, asked if, asked + person + to)

listenings.text: Good morning, everyone. I know this has been a strange few weeks, so let me be clear about three things. First, our brand will stay. Our customers know us, and that is not going to change. Second, nobody on this team is losing their job this year. I asked for that in writing, and the new owners agreed. Third, I will not pretend that everything stays the same. Our systems will move to the new platform next spring, and some of our processes will change. If you have a concern, do not keep it to yourself. Priya Shah, our head of HR, is your point person for any question about people, pay or benefits. We will hold a town hall every month, and I will answer every question I can. I cannot promise that it will be easy, but I can promise that you will hear the news from me first.

Hi Carlos, it's Priya Shah from HR. Thanks for your time at the kickoff this morning. I'm calling about two things. First, could you send me your org chart by Wednesday? I need it to map the teams before the first town hall. Second, I need to flag a risk. Our payroll system can't talk to yours yet, and the first joint payroll is in six weeks. I spoke to IT, and they told me that they could build a bridge, but they need a decision from the steering committee. Also, morale is better than last week, but people are still nervous about the bonus plan. If Diana can say something about bonuses before the town hall, that would reassure a lot of people. Call me back when you can. Thanks.
